attachments.metadata: Live acquired-resource state, separate from frozen record_revision
attachments.range: bytes=start-end; at most 8 MiB; pin ETag with If-Match and verify final sha256
attachments.sources: QQ archived assets BLOB; WeChat acquired media files only

coverage: Earliest/latest timestamps do not establish historical completeness; subsequent upstream revisions/media updates are unsupported

cursor_retention.changes: No pruning in V1; valid while dataset and signing key persist

order.context: sent_at ascending (null first), change_seq as tiebreaker

revision: Frozen first-observed record_revision=1; inserts only; body is exactly the captured revision

routes.GET /v1/attachments: Current acquired attachments for a captured record_id
routes.GET /v1/attachments/{attachment_id}: Current acquired attachment metadata and availability
routes.GET /v1/attachments/{attachment_id}/cont: Authenticated bytes; single bounded Range for large resources
routes.GET /v1/changes: Scoped insert revisions after a change cursor
routes.GET /v1/messages: Scoped literal substring and historical query
routes.POST /v1/context: Read at most 25 preceding and 25 following conversation messages
routes.POST /v1/records: Read up to 100 IDs with per-item revision status
routes.POST /v1/snapshots: Create a stable captured-data snapshot and change boundary

search: Case-sensitive literal Unicode substring; %, _, quotes and SQL syntax remain literal

time.captured_at: Service observation time in ISO 8601 UTC
time.ingested_at: Original archive ingestion timestamp; null for WeChat
time.last_successful_collection_at: QQ ISO 8601 UTC; WeChat Unix seconds encoded as string
time.sent_at: Unix seconds UTC; null when unavailable
